question: How is the heart of dissolution related to the heart of creation?
premises: Having become pure feeling, this reality dissolves in the self of dissolution.
That is called the heart of dissolution.
The same heart is regarded as foundational in creation.
inference: Therefore dissolution and creation share one underlying heart of consciousness.
uncertainties: prācyaṃ can mean prior, eastern, or original; the verse leaves the emphasis open.
plain_english: Having become pure feeling, this dissolves in the self of dissolution. That is the heart of dissolution, and in creation it is regarded as the same foundational Heart.
